counter-info.desc: This is the percentage of cache misses. The sum of read_io_type DISK and HYA_HDD. Unlike the other dblade-origin counters in this object, this counter already has its own native base counter (cache_miss_rate_base) and is carried over unchanged.
counter-info.name: cache_miss_rate

counter-info.desc: This is the total number of WAFL read requests. It is used as a base counter (or denominator) for the cache_miss_rate counter. Typed CM_CNT_DELTA so clients can cook this counter themselves if they wish. This counter is exactly similar to the read_io_type_base counter from the workload object.
counter-info.name: cache_miss_rate_base

counter-info.desc: The average CPU Dblade background service time per operation. This is the CPU service time for background operations done for this workload in the Dblade. Direct represents service time directly tallied for the workload. Wafl_cp represents service time contributed by the WAFL_CP workload on behalf of this workload. The WAFL_CP workload performs disk write operations. Background_delete represents service time contributed by the BACKGROUND_DELETE workload on behalf of this workload. The BACKGROUND_DELETE workload performs block deletions on disks. Readahead_x_stripe represents service time contributed by the RA_STRIPE_X workload on behalf of this workload. The RA_STRIPE_X workload performs read-ahead operations to improve disk read performance. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: cpu_dblade_background_service_time

counter-info.desc: The average CPU Dblade residence time per operation. This is the CPU service time plus the wait time for operations done for this workload in the Dblade. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: cpu_dblade_residence_time

counter-info.desc: The average CPU Dblade utilization service time per operation. This is the CPU service time for operations done for this workload in the Dblade. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: cpu_dblade_util_service_time

counter-info.desc: The average CPU Nblade residence time per operation. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: cpu_nblade_residence_time

counter-info.desc: The average CPU Nblade util service time per operation. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: cpu_nblade_util_service_time

counter-info.desc: The number of times the AV delay center was visited, aggregated cluster-wide. Informational only - not used as a base counter in this object (delay_avscan_wait_time is averaged against the shared iops counter instead).
counter-info.name: delay_avscan_num_visits

counter-info.desc: The average op wait time per operation due to AntiVirus Scan. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_avscan_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average time spent per operation doing I/O in object store (Cloud).
counter-info.name: delay_cloud_io_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average Cluster interconnect wait time per operation. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_cluster_interconnect_wait_time

counter-info.desc: This captures the number of times, ops are suspended/ delayed as COP (Container OverProvisioning) subsystem makes the volume ready for accepting work, aggregated cluster-wide. This can be either introduced as the volume is transitioned from COP passive state to active state. Or, it can be introduced when a volume is explicit restrained to be dirtied in the next CP (Consistency Point), which might be already overloaded. Unlike the other dblade-origin counters in this object, this counter already has its own native visit count and is carried over unchanged as the base counter for delay_cop_wait_time below.
counter-info.name: delay_cop_num_wait

counter-info.desc: This captures the average delay in ops which are suspended/delayed as COP (Container OverProvisioning) subsystem makes the volume ready for accepting work. This can be either introduced as the volume is transitioned from COP passive state to active state. Or, it can be introduced when a volume is explicit restrained to be dirtied in the next CP (Consistency Point), which might be already overloaded.
counter-info.name: delay_cop_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average disk IO wait time per operation. This is the time spent waiting for a read from disk to complete for this workload. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_disk_io_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average time spent per operation in RAL fetching from the remote volume for flexcache.
counter-info.name: delay_flexcache_ral_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average time spent per operation in spinhi performing the remote op for flexcache.
counter-info.name: delay_flexcache_spinhi_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average Network wait time per operation. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_network_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average NVLog transfer wait time per operation. This is the time spent waiting for a dma transfer to local nvram and remote nvram for writes. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_nvlog_transfer_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average QoS Limit wait time per operation. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_qos_limit_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average QoS wait time per operation for requests that were throttled so that some other workload could achieve its minimum throughput. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_qos_min_throughput_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average time spent per operation in the secondary path for sync replication.
counter-info.name: delay_sync_repl_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average time spent per operation in the WAFL Response queue.
counter-info.name: delay_wafl_response_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average WAFL suspended cp wait time per operation. This is the time spent in WAFL waiting for a CP to complete for this workload. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: delay_wafl_susp_cp_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average WAFL suspended other wait time per operation. This is the time spent in WAFL waiting for other suspend reasons to complete for this workload.
counter-info.name: delay_wafl_susp_other_wait_time

counter-info.desc: The average Disk HDD background service time per operation. This is the amount of time HDDs spend servicing requests by this workload. Direct represents service time directly tallied for the workload. Wafl_cp represents service time contributed by the WAFL_CP workload on behalf of this workload. Background_delete represents service time contributed by the BACKGROUND_DELETE workload on behalf of this workload. Readahead_x_stripe represents service time contributed by the RA_STRIPE_X workload on behalf of this workload. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: disk_hdd_background_service_time

counter-info.desc: The average disk SSD background service time per operation. This is the amount of time SSDs spend servicing requests by this workload. Direct represents service time directly tallied for the workload. Wafl_cp represents service time contributed by the WAFL_CP workload on behalf of this workload. Background_delete represents service time contributed by the BACKGROUND_DELETE workload on behalf of this workload. Readahead_x_stripe represents service time contributed by the RA_STRIPE_X workload on behalf of this workload. Units are microseconds.
counter-info.name: disk_ssd_background_service_time

counter-info.desc: Internal mirror of instance_name, used only as the cluster-wide automatic aggregation key for this object.
counter-info.name: instance_name

counter-info.desc: Internal. Used only as the cluster-wide automatic aggregation key for this object. This is the workload UUID without the node-name qualifier that instance_uuid carries, so that every node's row for the same workload aggregates into one cluster-wide instance.
counter-info.name: instance_uuid

counter-info.desc: This is the rate of workload operations that completed during the measurement interval, as measured at the N-blade layer. This counter also serves as the base counter for total_latency, the one other counter in this object that shares its exact 3-element (read/write/other) shape. Every other averaged delay/service-time counter below (nblade- and dblade- origin, none of which have a per-op-type breakdown) uses the iops_total counter instead. There is no native dblade-side operation count, so this N-blade rate is reused as an approximation when averaging dblade-origin counters below.
counter-info.name: iops

counter-info.desc: This is a convenience counter: the scalar sum of iops[read] + iops[write] + iops[other]. It exists solely to serve as the base counter (denominator) for the scalar (and 4-element background-service-time) averaged counters below, none of which have a per-op-type breakdown of their own. iops itself is a 3-element array and cannot be used directly as a base counter for a scalar or differently-shaped average - only total_latency, which shares iops's exact 3-element shape, can divide against iops element-by-element. Typed CM_CNT_DELTA so clients can cook this counter themselves if they wish. A base counter's own declared type has no effect on the AVERAGE division, which always operates on raw sample deltas regardless of it.
counter-info.name: iops_total

counter-info.desc: System node name
counter-info.name: node_name

counter-info.desc: System node id
counter-info.name: node_uuid

counter-info.desc: Ontap process that provided this instance
counter-info.name: process_name

counter-info.desc: This is rate of data read per second by the workload during the measurement interval, aggregated cluster-wide.
counter-info.name: read_data

counter-info.desc: This is the average response time for requests that were initiated by the workload, aggregated cluster-wide. Read requests, write requests and other requests are reported by this counter.
counter-info.name: total_latency

counter-info.desc: This is the rate of data written per second by the workload during the measurement interval, aggregated cluster-wide.
counter-info.name: write_data
